name: Body Gloss

features.text: Polishes paint, glass, chrome and tires.
Body Gloss™ is a "must" product for your showroom vehicles. Restores rubber and plastic surfaces dulled by UV damage.
Also used as a lubricant for Miracle Clay #31231 and other paint-preparation clay bars
Body Shop safe and VOC compliant

description: A pink, ready-to-use solution with a pleasant cherry scent. Removes fingerprints, dust and smudges from paint, metal and glass surfaces of the vehicle. The perfect spray-and-wipe showroom polish.
application: Apply Body Gloss™ sparingly to surface with a trigger sprayer. Polish immediately with a soft cloth or towel. Not recommended for heavily-soiled surfaces.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Abrasiveness - 0 Gloss - 6 Durability - 2
